project.name: BottleResult
project.title: BottleResult — Explainable & Verifiable School Result Intelligence Platform
project.description: Every Result Has a Reason. Deterministic school marks processing, GPA engine, explainable calculation traces, scrutiny checking center, audit trails, and cryptographic QR public verification.

features: 100% Deterministic result calculation engine (Pure, Isolated, Tested)
Configurable Bangladesh SSC grading rules & component pass thresholds
Per-subject explainable calculation trace ('Why this result?')
Automated Checking Center for scrutiny of compulsory failures, practical issues, absences, and low GP
Interactive Marks Management with live recalculation and old vs new GPA comparison
Immutable audit trail logging all state mutations and corrections
Public result search and transcript portal
QR code digital authenticity verification with secure tokens
Official printable transcript layout & instant PDF generation
Live data-driven analytics charts and statistical insights across 25 cohorts
Interactive Judge Demo mode with curated guided walkthroughs
Command Palette (Cmd/Ctrl + K) for rapid navigation
